name: How tall
question: Height from base to top, in meters. Each gridline step is ten times taller.

items.name: Adult giraffe
items.fact: A giraffe's neck has seven vertebrae, the same as yours.

items.name: Christ the Redeemer statue
items.fact: The statue is struck by lightning several times a year.

items.name: Horseshoe Falls (Niagara)
items.fact: Niagara Falls is slowly eroding upstream.

items.name: Leaning Tower of Pisa
items.fact: The tower started leaning during construction, in the 12th century.

items.name: Statue of Liberty (with pedestal)
items.fact: The Statue of Liberty's copper skin is about as thick as two pennies.

items.name: Big Ben (Elizabeth Tower)
items.fact: Big Ben is officially the name of the bell, not the tower.

items.name: Saturn V rocket
items.fact: Saturn V remains one of the tallest rockets ever flown.

items.name: Hyperion, the tallest known tree
items.fact: Hyperion's exact location is kept secret to protect it.

items.name: Great Pyramid of Giza (original)
items.fact: It was the tallest human-made structure for almost 4,000 years.

items.name: Space Needle
items.fact: The Space Needle was built for the 1962 World's Fair.

items.name: Eiffel Tower
items.fact: The Eiffel Tower grows about 15 cm in summer heat.

items.name: Empire State Building (to tip)
items.fact: The Empire State Building gets its own ZIP code.

items.name: CN Tower
items.fact: The CN Tower was the world's tallest free-standing structure for 31 years.

items.name: Burj Khalifa
items.fact: You can watch the sunset twice: once from the ground and again from the top.

items.name: Angel Falls
items.fact: Angel Falls is the world's highest uninterrupted waterfall.

items.name: Table Mountain
items.fact: Table Mountain is one of the oldest mountains in the world.

items.name: Mount Fuji
items.fact: Mount Fuji last erupted in 1707.

items.name: Mont Blanc
items.fact: Mont Blanc's height changes from year to year with its ice cap.

items.name: Kilimanjaro
items.fact: Kilimanjaro is the tallest free-standing mountain on land.

items.name: Mount Everest
items.fact: Everest grows a few millimeters a year as India pushes into Asia.

items.name: Olympus Mons, Mars
items.fact: Olympus Mons is about two and a half times as high as Everest.
